description: This file defines a Java interface CustomerRepository extending JpaRepository, providing data access methods for Customer entities such as finding customers by first and last names.

classes.name: CustomerRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Customer entity providing custom finder methods.

methods.name: findByLastName
methods.description: Finds a list of Customer entities matching the specified last name.

methods.name: findByFirstName
methods.description: Finds a list of Customer entities matching the specified first name.
